"""Prefix-query benchmark: dict-node trie vs bisect-based sorted list.

Structures expose the same API:
  count_prefix(p)            -> number of inserted words starting with p
  list_prefix(p, limit=None) -> up to `limit` matching words in sorted order

The trie stores subtree word-counts at every node, so count_prefix is
O(len(p)). A naive trie (no counts, full subtree walk) is included as a
baseline. Run this file to execute the benchmark; test_prefix.py holds
the pytest fuzz tests.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import bisect
import random
import time


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Trie with subtree counts at each node
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TrieNode:
    __slots__ = ("children", "count")

    def __init__(self):
        self.children = {}
        self.count = 0  # number of words in this subtree (including endings here)


class Trie:
    """Dict-node trie; count_prefix is O(len(p)) thanks to stored counts."""

    def __init__(self, words=()):
        self.root = TrieNode()
        self.n_words = 0
        for w in words:
            self.insert(w)

    def insert(self, word):
        node = self.root
        node.count += 1
        for ch in word:
            nxt = node.children.get(ch)
            if nxt is None:
                nxt = TrieNode()
                node.children[ch] = nxt
            node = nxt
            node.count += 1
        self.n_words += 1

    def _find(self, p):
        node = self.root
        for ch in p:
            node = node.children.get(ch)
            if node is None:
                return None
        return node

    def count_prefix(self, p):
        node = self._find(p)
        return 0 if node is None else node.count

    def list_prefix(self, p, limit=None):
        node = self._find(p)
        if node is None:
            return []
        out = []
        stack = [(node, p)]
        while stack and (limit is None or len(out) < limit):
            n, s = stack.pop()
            # A word ends at n iff it has no marker... we need end markers.
            # We rely on: a node is a word-end iff its key path was inserted;
            # tracked via a sentinel child below.
            raise NotImplementedError  # replaced below

    # NOTE: real implementation uses an end-of-word sentinel; see class _End


# The version above shows why a sentinel is needed; the real class follows.
class Trie:
    """Dict-node trie storing subtree counts plus an end-of-word sentinel."""

    _END = "\0"

    def __init__(self, words=()):
        self.root = TrieNode()
        self.n_words = 0
        for w in words:
            self.insert(w)

    def insert(self, word):
        node = self.root
        node.count += 1
        for ch in word:
            nxt = node.children.get(ch)
            if nxt is None:
                nxt = TrieNode()
                node.children[ch] = nxt
            node = nxt
            node.count += 1
        end = node.children.get(self._END)
        if end is None:
            end = TrieNode()
            node.children[self._END] = end
        end.count += 1  # marks a word ending here
        self.n_words += 1

    def _find(self, p):
        node = self.root
        for ch in p:
            node = node.children.get(ch)
            if node is None:
                return None
        return node

    def count_prefix(self, p):
        node = self._find(p)
        return 0 if node is None else node.count

    def list_prefix(self, p, limit=None):
        start = self._find(p)
        if start is None:
            return []
        out = []
        stack = [start] if start.children.get(self._END) is None else [start]
        # iterative pre-order; emit word when passing through END sentinel
        stack = [(start, p)]
        while stack and (limit is None or len(out) < limit):
            node, s = stack.pop()
            end = node.children.get(self._END)
            if end is not None and end.count and (
                limit is None or len(out) < limit
            ):
                out.append(s)
            for ch, child in node.children.items():
                if ch != self._END:
                    stack.append((child, s + ch))
        return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Baseline: same trie shape but no counts -> count requires a subtree walk
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class NaiveNode:
    __slots__ = ("children", "is_word")

    def __init__(self):
        self.children = {}
        self.is_word = False


class NaiveTrie:
    def __init__(self, words=()):
        self.root = NaiveNode()
        self.n_words = 0
        for w in words:
            self.insert(w)

    def insert(self, word):
        node = self.root
        for ch in word:
            nxt = node.children.get(ch)
            if nxt is None:
                nxt = NaiveNode()
                node.children[ch] = nxt
            node = nxt
        node.is_word = True
        self.n_words += 1

    def count_prefix(self, p):
        node = self.root
        for ch in p:
            node = node.children.get(ch)
            if node is None:
                return 0
        # full subtree walk -- the cost the counted trie avoids
        n = 0
        stack = [node]
        while stack:
            cur = stack.pop()
            if cur.is_word:
                n += 1
            stack.extend(cur.children.values())
        return n

    def list_prefix(self, p, limit=None):
        node = self.root
        for ch in p:
            node = node.children.get(ch)
            if node is None:
                return []
        found = []
        stack = [(node, p)]
        while stack and (limit is None or len(found) < limit):
            cur, s = stack.pop()
            if cur.is_word:
                found.append(s)
            for ch, child in cur.children.items():
                stack.append((child, s + ch))
        return sorted(found)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bisect-based sorted list
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class SortedWords:
    """Sorted tuple of words; prefix range located with bisect_left."""

    def __init__(self, words=()):
        self.words = tuple(sorted(set(words)))

    @staticmethod
    def _successor(p):
        """Smallest string that sorts after every string starting with p."""
        if not p:
            return None  # every word matches the empty prefix
        i = len(p) - 1
        while i >= 0 and ord(p[i]) >= 0x10FFFF:
            i -= 1
        if i < 0:
            return None  # p is a string of U+10FFFFs; nothing can follow
        return p[:i] + chr(ord(p[i]) + 1)

    def _bounds(self, p):
        lo = bisect.bisect_left(self.words, p)
        succ = self._successor(p)
        hi = len(self.words) if succ is None else bisect.bisect_left(self.words, succ)
        return lo, hi

    def count_prefix(self, p):
        lo, hi = self._bounds(p)
        return hi - lo

    def list_prefix(self, p, limit=None):
        lo, hi = self._bounds(p)
        if limit is not None:
            hi = min(hi, lo + limit)
        return list(self.words[lo:hi])


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Benchmark
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
SYLLABLES = [
    "ba", "be", "bi", "bo", "bu", "da", "de", "di", "do", "du",
    "ka", "ke", "ki", "ko", "ku", "la", "le", "li", "lo", "lu",
    "ma", "me", "mi", "mo", "mu", "na", "ne", "ni", "no", "nu",
    "ra", "re", "ri", "ro", "ru", "ta", "te", "ti", "to", "tu",
]


def generate_words(n, seed=42):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    words = set()
    while len(words) < n:
        k = rng.randint(3, 5)
        words.add("".join(rng.choice(SYLLABLES) for _ in range(k)))
    return sorted(words)


def generate_queries(words, n_queries=50_000, seed=7):
    """Mixed workload: dense short prefixes, medium, and long/rare ones."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    dense = [w[: rng.randint(1, 2)] for w in rng.sample(words, min(4000, len(words)))]
    medium = [w[: rng.randint(3, 6)] for w in rng.sample(words, min(4000, len(words)))]
    long_q = [w + "xx" for w in rng.sample(words, min(2000, len(words)))]
    queries = []
    buckets = [dense, medium, long_q]
    weights = [0.4, 0.35, 0.25]
    for _ in range(n_queries):
        b = rng.choices(buckets, weights)[0]
        queries.append(rng.choice(b))
    return queries, dense


def bench(fn, *args):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    fn(*args)
    return time.perf_counter() - t0


def main():
    t_total0 = time.perf_counter()

    print("Generating words...", flush=True)
    words = generate_words(200_000)
    queries, dense_queries = generate_queries(words)
    print(f"  {len(words)} words, {len(queries)} queries "
          f"({len(dense_queries)} distinct dense prefixes)\n")

    # ---- build -----------------------------------------------------------
    t0 = time.perf_counter(); trie = Trie(words);          t_trie_build = time.perf_counter() - t0
    t0 = time.perf_counter(); naive = NaiveTrie(words);    t_naive_build = time.perf_counter() - t0
    t0 = time.perf_counter(); sorted_w = SortedWords(words); t_sorted_build = time.perf_counter() - t0

    # sanity: identical counts on a sample
    sample = queries[:500]
    assert all(trie.count_prefix(q) == sorted_w.count_prefix(q) for q in sample)
    assert all(trie.count_prefix(q) == naive.count_prefix(q) for q in sample[:50])

    # ---- queries ---------------------------------------------------------
    LIMIT = 20

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for q in queries:
        trie.count_prefix(q)
    t_trie_count = time.perf_counter() - t0

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for q in queries:
        trie.list_prefix(q, LIMIT)
    t_trie_list = time.perf_counter() - t0

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for q in queries:
        sorted_w.count_prefix(q)
    t_sorted_count = time.perf_counter() - t0

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for q in queries:
        sorted_w.list_prefix(q, LIMIT)
    t_sorted_list = time.perf_counter() - t0

    # Naive walk is expensive: measure on a subset and report per-query cost.
    NAIVE_N = 300
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for q in dense_queries[:NAIVE_N]:
        naive.count_prefix(q)
    t_naive_count_sub = time.perf_counter() - t0
    naive_per_query = t_naive_count_sub / NAIVE_N
    t_naive_count_est = naive_per_query * len(queries)

    # Per-query comparison on the SAME dense queries (apples to apples).
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for q in dense_queries[:NAIVE_N]:
        trie.count_prefix(q)
    trie_dense_per_query = (time.perf_counter() - t0) / NAIVE_N

    speedup = naive_per_query / trie_dense_per_query

    # ---- report ----------------------------------------------------------
    def us(t, n=len(queries)):
        return f"{t / n * 1e6:8.2f}"

    print("| Structure       | Operation            | Build (s) | Total query (s) | µs/query |")
    print("|-----------------|----------------------|-----------|-----------------|----------|")
    print(f"| Trie (counted)  | build                | {t_trie_build:9.3f} | —               | —        |")
    print(f"| Trie (counted)  | count_prefix x{n} | {'—':>9} | {t_trie_count:15.3f} | {us(t_trie_count)} |")
    print(f"| Trie (counted)  | list_prefix x{n}   | {'—':>9} | {t_trie_list:15.3f} | {us(t_trie_list)} |")
    print(f"| SortedWords     | build                | {t_sorted_build:9.3f} | —               | —        |")
    print(f"| SortedWords     | count_prefix x{n} | {'—':>9} | {t_sorted_count:15.3f} | {us(t_sorted_count)} |")
    print(f"| SortedWords     | list_prefix x{n}   | {'—':>9} | {t_sorted_list:15.3f} | {us(t_sorted_list)} |")
    print(f"| NaiveTrie       | build                | {t_naive_build:9.3f} | —               | —        |")
    print(f"| NaiveTrie       | count_prefix x{n} | {'—':>9} | {t_naive_count_est:15.3f} | {naive_per_query * 1e6:8.2f} |")
    print(f"\n(list_prefix limit={LIMIT}; NaiveTrie count extrapolated from {NAIVE_N} dense queries)")

    print(f"\nDense-prefix count_prefix per query: "
          f"trie={trie_dense_per_query * 1e6:.3f}µs, "
          f"naive-walk={naive_per_query * 1e6:.3f}µs, speedup={speedup:.1f}x")
    assert speedup >= 10.0, (
        f"count_prefix expected to beat naive subtree walk by >=10x, got {speedup:.1f}x"
    )
    print("ASSERT OK: counted-trie count_prefix >= 10x faster than naive subtree walk on dense prefixes.")

    print(f"\nTotal wall time: {time.perf_counter() - t_total0:.2f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
